programs.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Hot Hot Heat"
programs.desc: This week's experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat, how a little bit of melted candle wax can turn into a bomb, and why heat is an essential ingredient in cooking an egg.

programs.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Explosive Elements"
programs.desc: This week's experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programs.title: Bright Now S1 - "Engineering A Pro"
programs.desc: The face of baseball is rapidly changing. The next generation of major league stars are using cutting-edge science and technology to drive their performance to unprecedented heights.

programs.title: Bright Now S1 - "Evolution of Flavor"
programs.desc: We are obsessed with flavor, yet taste is the most overlooked sense. Surprising new discoveries are changing our understanding of taste, and how it has evolved to keep us alive.

programs.title: Bright Now S1 - "Iberian Lynx: Saving the World's Most Endangered Cat"
programs.sub_title: Iberian Lynx: Saving the World's Most Endangered Cat
programs.desc: The Iberian Lynx, classified as the world's most endangered cat, was once close to total extinction. Now, a group of scientists and conservationists are battling to repopulate the species, giving hope that these elusive animals may one day comeback.

programs.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Test"
programs.desc: The new version of the Flying Kestrel is ready to be put to the test at one of the most state of the art wind tunnels. Has the team done enough to create a record-breaking car?
